limitations: This is opened POST-FIX canary development data, not a new holdout.
V4 changes acquisition and delegates continuous tracking to the unchanged V3 core; it is not a new tracker.

The frozen Standard source trajectory and V3/V4 acquisition use wider and/or odd-Qin evidence. Odd Qin is fit-withheld only from the downstream rate fit, not from upstream acquisition or source selection.
Future odd-Qin CFO is a comparative response, not physical Doppler truth.
Receiver and LNB clock drift remain unmodeled.
No satellite identity, absolute TOA, pseudorange, or carrier-phase continuity is claimed.
